spans.s:
m. (-तः)
1 A mountain, the eastern part of the Vindhya range, or that part in which the Revā rises.
2 A tree, (Cassia fistula.)
3 A name of Ś

A Daitya or demon.
5 The fifth MANU of the present Kalpa.
E.
रेवा the Revā river, aff. अञ्, and त added.

m. (-कः)
The mountain Raivata.
E.
कन् added to the preceding; also with ठक् added to रेवत, रैवतिक.
